decisions.title: Project name: AOTCHI
decisions.rationale: Epic philosophical saga, not childish — pirates, cyberpunk, retro-neon, philosophers

decisions.title: ERC-8004 first, then commerce
decisions.decision: Implement ERC-8004 identity before ERC-8183 commerce or x402 payments
decisions.rationale: Identity is foundational — agent must exist before it can earn or spend

decisions.title: CLI framework: commander.js
decisions.decision: Use commander.js + chalk for CLI, custom neon display module
decisions.rationale: Lightweight, well-known, easy to extend, no unnecessary dependencies

decisions.title: Metadata: base64 data URI
decisions.decision: Agent metadata stored as base64 data URI (data:application/json;base64,...)
decisions.rationale: No hosting needed for testnet; works immediately after registration

decisions.title: 8004scan: use endpoints field
decisions.decision: Use 'endpoints' not 'services' in agent metadata JSON for 8004scan compatibility
decisions.rationale: 8004scan parser expects 'endpoints' field; 'services' causes parse warnings and missing data

decisions.title: Docs structure: pergamins + manifest + index
decisions.decision: Living docs in /pergamins/ with manifest.json tracking artifacts, chapters, decisions
decisions.rationale: Chapters are narrative snapshots not modified; pergamins is the evolving source of truth

decisions.title: Docs naming: subfolders over filenames
decisions.rationale: Scales better, mirrors source layout, cleaner references in manifest
